acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The MS instrument was operated with a top-12 data-dependent acquisition strategy.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein pellets were suspended in 20 µL of 7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 100 mM ABC, 2 mM methylamine solution, followed by disulphide reduction and cysteine alkylation with 10 mM DTT for 30 min at 30⁰C and 30 mM CAA for 30 min  at room temperature in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were pre-digested with 1:100 (enzyme to protein) Lys-C for 2 h, diluted 5 times with 100 mM ABC and further digested with 1:50 trypsin overnight at 25⁰C .
